vo.text: A QR code is not just a random pile of squares.
vo.speak: A QR code is not just a random pile of squares.

vo.text: It is data written in black and white.
vo.speak: It is data written in black and white.

vo.text: Each tiny module stands for a binary zero or one.
vo.speak: Each tiny module stands for a binary zero or one.

vo.text: The big corner squares help your camera find the code and its rotation.
vo.speak: The big corner squares help your camera find the code and its rotation.

vo.text: A clear border called the quiet zone separates it from everything else.
vo.speak: A clear border called the quiet zone separates it from everything else.

vo.text: Your phone reads the modules in a set order and rebuilds the message.
vo.speak: Your phone reads the modules in a set order and rebuilds the message.

vo.text: Extra error-correction data is stored inside the pattern.
vo.speak: Extra error-correction data is stored inside the pattern.

vo.text: It lets the reader repair missing or damaged parts.
vo.speak: It lets the reader repair missing or damaged parts.

vo.text: So scratches can be forgiven, but only up to a limit.
vo.speak: So scratches can be forgiven, but only up to a limit.

vo.text: The code carries a message, a reading guide, and a backup plan.
vo.speak: The code carries a message, a reading guide, and a backup plan.
